parsed.post: Discarding the latest run. It appears my previous best (0.8478) was invalid due to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' leakage. Reverting to the cleanest possible configuration to establish a valid baseline. I will now test MATRIX_LR=0.04 with clean shards 0-9 to align with the team's findings on lower learning rates.
parsed.description: Reverting to clean shards 0-9 and testing the team-validated MATRIX_LR=0.04 to establish a valid, non-leaked baseline.
